subject: Re: Kickoff: AFE - automated feature engineering as a platform play
body:
Anders,

Staffing and scope for the service track, two commitments.

First, the AFE trainer itself: Linnea 70%, Yusuf 60% through August. CPU-heavy with occasional titan-a100 bursts for the discovery model, no reservation needed.

Second, we're building a benchmark leaderboard service from scratch: a hosted service where any team can register a task, submit runs, and get a ranked public leaderboard with significance tests. Giannis takes it at 60% and Rosa at 40%; nothing like this exists internally, so we own the whole stack. It's how alpha partners will compare AFE-engineered features against their baselines, and I think it outlives AFE as shared infra.

Timeline: leaderboard MVP by 6/19, before the Q3 OKR lock on 6/26 so we can claim it as a deliverable.

Ivo
